description: Dams and water storages 1990 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. Shows point location of large reservoirs in Australia owned by a public authority. Attribute information includes: -name of the dam wall and associated water body -name of the stream on which it is located -storage capacity and surface area of the water body -ownership -construction details of the dam wall. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are AU, Earth Sciences, GIS, GIS Dataset, National dataset. It offers 5 resource(s) in HTML, PDF, ZIP. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
